'''''Krayt''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] under the employ the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
The shuttle was on its way to the [[Bonadan system/Legends|Bonadan system]] with [[Inspector/Legends|inspectors]] to verify the cargo of several [[Class-A cargo container|Cargo containers]] that were being loaded by [[CT-11 space tug|space tugs]] and [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] were to pick up the containers. However, two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] were sent by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to destroy most, if not all the containers to deprive the Empire of the resources that the containers were to provide. The shuttle soon arrived and was shot down and destroyed before it could escape. The incident was recorded as the first training mission for new [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]].

*[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]
